svg.title: MARCUS architecture
svg.desc: The browser talks to nginx, which serves the web UI and passes /api/v2 to FastAPI on Postgres and Redis; Celery workers, one queue per kind of work, run the engines, four of them and the MARCUS model on the GPU.
svg.text: CELERY WORKERS · ONE QUEUE PER KIND OF WORK
Docker Compose · nginx is the only published port · no paper text leaves the server
